2023
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Mummineni Sudheer Kumar
 Writ Petition No.42259 Of 2022

entities.text: Nakirtha Bala Komuraiah vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The present Writ Petition is filed by the petitioners aggrieved by the action of the respondents in extending the rehabilitation and resettlement benefits in terms of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, in spite of passing an Award in proceedings No.A/4025/2013 dated 25.03.2017.
2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is the specific contention of the learned counsel for the petitioners that the sixth respondent herein, having considered the claim of the petitioners for extending the benefit of rehabilitation and resettlement, has already submitted a proposal to the fourth respondent vide letter bearing Rc.No.A/4025/2013-3 dated 05.01.2018 for approval but the said proposal is kept pending by the fourth respondent as on date and no action has been taken.

Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks indulgence of this Court to direct the fourth respondent to take immediate action on the proposal submitted by the sixth respondent through the letter dated 05.01.2018.

3. The written instructions placed before this Court by the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition also 2 MSK,J W.P.NO.42259 OF 2022 indicate that the said proposal submitted by the sixth respondent on 05.01.2018 is still pending with the fourth respondent.

4. In the light of the above, taking into consideration the fact that the proposal submitted by the sixth respondent as early as on 05.01.2018 is still pending consideration before the fourth respondent, this Court is of the considered view that this Writ Petition can be disposed of by issuing appropriate directions to the fourth respondent.

5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the fourth respondent to forthwith take steps for considering the proposal submitted by the sixth respondent through his letter bearing Rc.No.A/4025/2013-3 dated 05.01.2018 and pass appropriate orders thereon within a period of two (2) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous applications, if any, pending shall stand closed.
